findings.title: Payment Terms and Invoicing
findings.rationale: The evidence specifies the invoicing and payment terms that the Vendor and Client must adhere to under the Agreement.
evidence_excerpts: The Vendor shall issue invoices strictly in accordance with the rate structures defined in this Agreement, ensuring absolute alignment between delivered items, approved quantities, service activities performed, and the pricing committed within the rate card.

findings.title: Pricing Structure Defined
findings.rationale: The evidence provides a comprehensive overview of the pricing structure, including details on hardware supply, service rates, warranty costs, and logistics fees, ensuring clarity and predictability in financial interactions between the parties.
evidence_excerpts: The intent of this Agreement is to consolidate all device-level and service-level price specifications under a single authoritative document, ensuring standardization, preventing pricing disputes, and enabling the Client to forecast expenses with accuracy.

findings.title: Price Adjustment Mechanism
findings.rationale: The contract includes a mechanism for price adjustments based on market fluctuations and other factors, which indicates the presence of price escalation clauses.
evidence_excerpts: At the conclusion of each twelve-month cycle, the Parties may jointly review the rate card to determine if any adjustments are necessary based on raw material cost fluctuations, semiconductor market volatility, logistics cost changes, or macroeconomic factors.

findings.title: Renewal Pricing Terms
findings.rationale: The renewal pricing for Annual Maintenance Contracts (AMC) and extended warranty coverage is defined in the rate card, which states that once an AMC or extended warranty price is published, it remains applicable for devices procured within the contractual period, regardless of future market fluctuations.
evidence_excerpts: It is agreed that once an AMC or extended warranty price is published in this rate card, it shall remain applicable for devices procured within the contractual period, regardless of future market fluctuations or component shortages.
